title: Identity scalar tensor balancing preserves multiplication
statement: Let X be a scheme and R a sheaf of commutative rings on its small pro-etale site. Let a be a derived tensor model normalized on flat-term K-flat representatives [def-sf-compact-support-scalar-tensor-balancing]. Write F for derived extension along the identity of R, e:F≅Id for tensorIdentity [def-sf-ring-scalar-multiplication-unit], and μ for scalarTensor(Id_R,a,a). For all derived R-modules K,M, μ⁻¹_(K,M) followed by e_(a.tensor(K,M)) equals a.tensor(e_K,e_M). This concerns ordinary uncompleted extension and needs no constructibility or completeness.

proof.text: Conjugate the ordinary identity-on-sections restriction isomorphism to obtain its inverse multiplication unit. The normalized scalar adjunction identifies its value on x with 1 tensor x. Test the ordinary tensor equation on pure tensors: normalized balancing sends 1 tensor (x tensor y) to (1 tensor x) tensor (1 tensor y). Sum the inverse equation over every bidegree of the signed total, using coproduct hom extensionality and naturality of the ordinary unit.

Compute the derived identity restriction isomorphism through the exact-functor localization factorizations. The K-flat normalization of the derived adjunction then gives tensorIdentity.inv at QP followed by the universal scalar counit equal to Q of the ordinary unit chain map. Apply the normalization of scalarTensor on a flat K-flat pair. The total equation and naturality of the tensor representative isomorphism show that tensorIdentity.inv followed by scalarTensor.hom equals tensor of the two inverse units. Fully faithful restriction to representative pairs extends this natural-transformation equality to all derived pairs. Cancel the isomorphisms to obtain the stated equation.

lean.statement:
theorem scalarTensor_identity {X : Scheme.{u}}
    (R : Sheaf (ProEt.topology X) CommRingCat.{u + 1})
    (a : ProEtaleTensorModel X R) (K M : DerivedCategory (pbcModules X R)) :
    (scalarTensor (𝟙 R) a a).inv.app (K, M) ≫
        (tensorIdentity R).hom.app (a.tensor.obj (K, M)) =
      a.tensor.map (Prod.mkHom ((tensorIdentity R).hom.app K)
        ((tensorIdentity R).hom.app M))
